_comment: Entries already in the Register when the player sits down. The desk had somebody at it before. Two of these are a clerk doing his job; one of them is not, and the difference is a single phrase. Nothing in the slice explains it. That is the point.

entries.register_note: Instrument sound in every particular. Die live, date reduces clean. — R.V.
Two reckonings on one date. Sent up. See the Almanac, fol. 4, and mind whose chancery drew it. — R.V.
Nothing found against it. Fee for the writing, two marks, received of the party. — R.V.
